_about: The 36 risk and opportunity rules (section 5.16). Thresholds, severity, actions and owners are editable in the app (Library -> Risk rules). Behaviour thresholds are on a 0-4 score scale.

riskRules.name: Critical skill gap
riskRules.rule: Any skill is this many levels or more below its required level
riskRules.executiveAction: Prioritise the skill in the next development cycle and fund targeted training

riskRules.name: Critical gap on a priority skill
riskRules.rule: A priority skill (Priority = 2, the higher priority) is this many levels or more below required
riskRules.executiveAction: Escalate: assign a subject-matter mentor and a fast-track plan
riskRules.dataSource: Tech & Cross: Priority, Level, Required Level

riskRules.name: Broad capability shortfall
riskRules.rule: This share or more of assessed skills is below the required level
riskRules.executiveAction: Agree a structured 6-month recovery plan with monthly line manager review

riskRules.name: Technical readiness below target
riskRules.rule: Average technical gap is this many levels or more
riskRules.executiveAction: Focus the plan on technical certification and hands-on labs
riskRules.dataSource: Tech & Cross: Framework = Client Technical Framework (Digital & Cybersecurity)

riskRules.name: Cross-functional readiness below target
riskRules.rule: Average cross-functional gap is this many levels or more
riskRules.executiveAction: Enrol in the cross-functional training programme
riskRules.dataSource: Tech & Cross: Framework = Lexonis Cross-functional Competencies

riskRules.name: High-potential talent
riskRules.rule: This many skills or more above required, with no critical gap
riskRules.executiveAction: Consider for stretch assignments, mentoring others and the succession pool

riskRules.name: No proficiency in a required skill
riskRules.rule: Current level is 0 on a skill that requires level 1 or higher
riskRules.executiveAction: Start foundation training immediately and pair with an experienced colleague

riskRules.name: Gaps in both technical and cross-functional skills
riskRules.rule: Average gap is above zero in both frameworks
riskRules.executiveAction: Build a balanced plan covering both areas without overloading the employee

riskRules.name: Fully meets role requirements
riskRules.rule: No skill below its required level
riskRules.executiveAction: Recognise the achievement and set next-level targets for career progression

riskRules.name: Subject-matter expert
riskRules.rule: Level 4 (maximum) on this many skills or more
riskRules.executiveAction: Use as an internal trainer or mentor and run knowledge-sharing sessions

riskRules.name: Behavioural category below expectation
riskRules.rule: Any Personal Efficiency Performance category averages below this score
riskRules.executiveAction: Targeted coaching on that behavioural category

riskRules.name: Low behaviour rating
riskRules.rule: Any single behaviour is scored at or below this score
riskRules.executiveAction: Address with specific examples in the next coaching session

riskRules.name: Low programme attendance
riskRules.rule: Absent from this many Personal Efficiency Performance training days or more
riskRules.executiveAction: Line manager to confirm commitment and reschedule missed days

riskRules.name: Leadership and agility below expectation
riskRules.rule: Leadership + Agility average is below this score
riskRules.executiveAction: Leadership development programme or shadowing a senior leader

riskRules.name: Overall behavioural performance below expectation
riskRules.rule: Overall day average is below this score
riskRules.executiveAction: Agree a behavioural development focus with the coach

riskRules.name: Declining behavioural trend
riskRules.rule: Overall score falls by this much or more from first to last training day
riskRules.executiveAction: Coach to review the cause and agree corrective support
riskRules.dataSource: PEP DB: Training Day, Overall Day Avg

riskRules.name: Improving behavioural trend
riskRules.rule: Overall score rises by this much or more from first to last training day
riskRules.executiveAction: Acknowledge the progress with the employee and line manager
riskRules.dataSource: PEP DB: Training Day, Overall Day Avg

riskRules.name: Strong behavioural performer
riskRules.rule: Average behaviour score is at or above this score
riskRules.executiveAction: Nominate as a peer coach or for team lead opportunities

riskRules.name: Hands-on labs not started
riskRules.rule: Labs are assigned but none has been completed
riskRules.executiveAction: Set a monthly lab target and protected learning time

riskRules.name: Hands-on labs behind plan
riskRules.rule: Lab completion is above zero but below this share
riskRules.executiveAction: Agree catch-up milestones for the rest of the cycle

riskRules.name: Professional certification not defined
riskRules.rule: No professional certification is set in the plan
riskRules.executiveAction: Agree a role-aligned certification at the next plan review

riskRules.name: Artificial intelligence certification not defined
riskRules.rule: No artificial intelligence certification is set in the plan
riskRules.executiveAction: Assign the appropriate artificial intelligence certification track

riskRules.name: No coaching recorded
riskRules.rule: No coaching session recorded in the current cycle
riskRules.executiveAction: Schedule a coaching session within two weeks

riskRules.name: Training absence
riskRules.rule: Any training marked Absent or Partially Attended, or status Need to be rescheduled
riskRules.executiveAction: Re-enrol in the next session and confirm availability

riskRules.name: Cross-functional hours behind plan
riskRules.rule: Attended cross-functional hours are below this share of the 35-hour plan
riskRules.executiveAction: Book the remaining cross-functional courses for this cycle

riskRules.name: Artificial intelligence certification training not attended
riskRules.rule: An artificial intelligence certification is assigned but the 40-hour course has not been attended
riskRules.executiveAction: Schedule the artificial intelligence certification course this cycle
riskRules.dataSource: IDP Certs: AI Cert; Trainings: AI-CERT

riskRules.name: Labs started but not completed
riskRules.rule: Assigned lab content is started but not complete
riskRules.executiveAction: Set a completion date and check progress monthly

riskRules.name: Repeated training absence
riskRules.rule: Absent from this many training sessions or more
riskRules.executiveAction: Line manager conversation on commitment and workload

riskRules.name: No training attended this cycle
riskRules.rule: No training attended in the current cycle
riskRules.executiveAction: Agree a training schedule with the employee this month

riskRules.name: Limited coaching
riskRules.rule: Only one coaching session recorded
riskRules.executiveAction: Book a follow-up coaching session to embed the learning

riskRules.name: Self-assessment outstanding
riskRules.rule: Self-Assessment is Not Done
riskRules.executiveAction: Employee to complete the self-assessment; line manager to follow up

riskRules.name: Validation interview outstanding
riskRules.rule: Validation Interview is Not Done
riskRules.executiveAction: Schedule the validation interview

riskRules.name: Validation report not issued
riskRules.rule: Validation Interview Report is Not Started
riskRules.executiveAction: Issue the validation report to the employee and line manager

riskRules.name: Team at risk
riskRules.rule: This share or more of a line manager's team (3+ people) has a critical skill gap
riskRules.executiveAction: Review the team's development plan with the line manager and consider team-wide training
riskRules.dataSource: Tech & Cross; SOT Users: Line Manager

riskRules.name: Section at risk
riskRules.rule: This share or more of a section (3+ people) has a critical skill gap
riskRules.executiveAction: Prioritise the section in the Academy training calendar

riskRules.name: Organisation-wide skill gap
riskRules.rule: This share or more of assessed employees is below required on the same skill
riskRules.executiveAction: Commission a group-wide training programme for that skill
